title: Graph Encoding for LLMs: The 'Talk like a Graph' Initiative
summary: This community centers on the 2023 arXiv paper 'Talk like a Graph: Encoding Graphs for Large Language Models,' authored by Bahare Fatemi, Jonathan Halcrow, and Bryan Perozzi. The work addresses the challenge of integrating graph-structured data into Large Language Models (LLMs). It is cited within a broader context of research focusing on the intersection of graph machine learning, knowledge graphs, and LLM capabilities.
key_findings: The paper 'Talk like a Graph: Encoding Graphs for Large Language Models' was published in 2023 on arXiv (arXiv:2310.04560).
Bahare Fatemi, Jonathan Halcrow, and Bryan Perozzi are the three identified authors of this specific work.

The work is referenced alongside other 2023-2024 studies on 'Graph Machine Learning in the Era of Large Language Models' and 'Knowledge Solver,' indicating a trend toward combining graph structures with LLMs.
